title: Stay in Elvis'  Personal Suite. Guitar-Shaped Pool
description:
The pool will be open May 1. We are Airbnb Superhosts!Elvis chose our condo as his private Nashville suite.Recently-renovated,one-bedroom,close to downtown (Broadway)in walking distance of many attractions and restaurants.Decorated with country music memorabilia, all new furnishings in Sept. 2018.Comfortable king-size bed and very comfortable state-of-the-art queen sofa bed (No Bars) with memory foam mattress.

The space
We are located on the sixth floor of the historic Spence Manor building, which was originally built as a five-star hotel for Elvis to stay when he recorded at the historic RCA Studio B.    Other notables who stayed at Spence Manor include The Beatles, Johnny Cash, Willie Nelson, and many more. The building has been converted into individually-owned condos. It is nice to return "home" to a quiet condo. The location is very convenient to downtown, where country music reigns, Vanderbilt University, Belmont University, and The Gulch. Broadway with its many honky-tonks, is located about a mile away, a $5-6 Uber/Lyft ride, usually. Many record labels and publishing companies, as well as restaurants and bars,  are located within the block. A guitar-shaped pool welcomes you, usually from May until the end of September.  This could vary, depending upon the weather. Washer/dryer in condo,  iron, ironing board, hairdryer and linens provided.Large walk-in closet. View of guitar-shaped pool and adjacent Owen Bradley park from both living room and bedroom. TV is NetFlix capable. Bathroom has both a walk-in shower and a separate bathtub. BBQ grill in pool area. Kitchen has full-size dishwasher, stove, refrigerator and over-the-stove microwave. Very well stocked with dishes, cookware, linens. Fast, secure internet.Cable TV.   Free on-site parking.Washer/dryer.  We have been in the short-term rental business since the 1990's and pride ourselves on the cleanliness and comfort that our rentals provide for our guests. Fast, secure internet.Cable TV.  Free on-site parking.Washer/dryer. The short term rental permit is:  T2020018194.

Guest access
Electronic lock system. Self check-in with keypad.  Guests have complete access to the condo, with the exception of a small, locked storage closet.

Other things to note
+++Rates for CMA Fest are $375 per night with a five-night minimum. Please contact us if you have questions.
The pool is usually open from May until the end of the summer.

Unforeseen circumstances happen so we strongly advise you to purchase trip insurance in case you have flight problems, sickness, or other circumstances!
